svg.title: Classroom Presence System tap station
svg.desc: Illustration of the tap station: a monitor showing the Live Dashboard, a Raspberry Pi keyboard and mouse, a Raspberry Pi 4 with a PN532 NFC HAT, labeled RFID cards, and a webcam with a Mac Mini for camera cross-verification, on a wooden desk in front of window blinds.

g.text: CS Honors Period 2 · Manually started · 42:10 remaining
